requirements.text: A mobile-friendly system for study room bookings that allows students to easily select a date and time, view room capacity, and receive immediate confirmation.
Reminders for book returns sent via phone or email, ideally one or two days before the due date, along with a central view of all current loans and their due dates.
An easy way to check room availability and book study rooms online to prevent frustration and long waits associated with the current system.
A feature to check real-time book availability, allowing students to see if a book is on the shelf or checked out.
A recommendation system for popular books to help students find materials quickly and easily.
